knowHow.text: Making tooling, equipment, and manufacturing aids.
AthenaX CF10 is the perfect material for 3D printing wear resistant parts.
No enclosure, or heated chamber needed.
This engineering filament is very easy to 3D print on open desktop machines.
This filament is stiff and still impact resistant.
Masking layer lines with a matt surface finish in 3D printed objects
Its low shrinkage factor and perfect layer adhesion make AthenaX CF10 a breeze to print with.
PCTG is moderately hygroscopic and therefore it is recommended to pre-dry the filament at 75°C for approximately 24 hours before usage
We recommend to use ruby nozzles or hardened steel nozzles.
In general these carbon fibers will accelerate the nozzle-wear of brass nozzles, much faster than unfilled filaments.
Please be aware that carbon fiber reinforced filaments contain a relatively high concentration of extremely hard carbon fibers, which have an abrasive nature.
For optimal print results we recommend to print AthenaX CF10 filament from a drying box to avoid that the material can accumulate humidity from the environment.
The addition of carbon fiber makes the PCTG+CF filament significantly stiffer than standard PCTG.
